day.title: The day, join-in longtail

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel until 08:30, then Lanta Old Town pier, where the guide briefs you before the trip.
The boat leaves. The longtail takes about 45 minutes to reach the first island.
steps.detail: About 45 minutes to the first island

steps.text: Koh Chueak, snorkelling over the reef, about 45 minutes.
Koh Mook, swim through the Emerald Cave to the hidden lagoon.
Lunch buffet on the beach, then time to swim.
Koh Ma, snorkelling for about 45 minutes.
Back on Koh Lanta between 14:30 and 15:30, depending on the sea, then transfer to your hotel.

beforeYouBook.pickup: From your hotel. The longtails and the join-in speedboat leave from Lanta Old Town pier.
bring: Cash for the national park fee
beforeYouBook.weather: The national park can close an island at short notice, for example for jellyfish. We then change the route or move the date.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Join-in speedboat: tell us at least 12 hours before departure, or the full price is charged. Join-in longtail and private longtail: we confirm the conditions with you when you book.

faq.q: Longtail or speedboat for the 4 Islands?
faq.a: The longtail is the traditional wooden boat, slower and open, and it visits Koh Ma. The speedboat is faster and visits Koh Kradan instead. Both include lunch and snorkel gear.
It can be. Join a shared boat, or take a private longtail for your group only, with its own captain.

faq.q: Is the national park fee included?
faq.a: No. You pay 200 THB per adult and 100 THB per child from 4 to 11 in cash to the ranger on the island. Children under 4 do not pay.
Yes. Children from 4 to 11 pay a child rate and children under 4 travel free on the join-in boats. Life jackets are on board. Give us the ages when you book.

legacyText.title: 4 Islands Tour from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: The 4 Islands sit south of Koh Lanta, in the Trang sea. The longtail route stops at Koh Chueak, Koh Mook, Koh Ngai and Koh Ma. The speedboat route swaps Koh Ma for Koh Kradan. On a private longtail you can add Koh Kradan as a detour.
At Koh Mook you swim through the Emerald Cave and come out in a lagoon enclosed by cliffs. Lunch is a Thai buffet on the beach, on Koh Ngai with the longtail and on Koh Kradan with the speedboat.
legacyText.cardDescription: Koh Ma, Koh Mook and Koh Chueak, plus Koh Kradan or Koh Ngai: your choice.
goodToKnow: Join-in or private. On a private longtail the schedule is flexible and you choose the order of the islands.
Children have their own rate. Children under 4 go free on the join-in boats. Give us the ages when you book.
Times vary a little with the sea and the season. The longtail is back between 14:30 and 15:30.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The national park fee is paid on the island and is not included.
legacyText.parkFee: 200 THB per adult and 100 THB per child (Thai nationals 40 and 20 THB)
legacyText.caption: Koh Ngai
